existing_processes.description: Logistics and volume management find gas flowing at a meter with no deal, an expired deal or volumes on the strangers gas contract, and chase the deal owner to create or extend a Sitara ticket or approve a write-off to unaccounted-for gas.
existing_processes.name: Meter flow with missing or expired deal resolution

existing_processes.description: Staff research meter allocation exceptions, UA4 and unaccounted-for differences, bad feeds and volume mismatches between pipeline, counterparty and internal systems, then move volumes or correct allocations.
existing_processes.name: Meter volume and allocation variance resolution

existing_processes.description: Settlements, accounting or counterparties report a price or volume mismatch between an invoice, a payment and the booked deal, and the desk verifies, disputes or corrects the deal so the invoice can be finaled.
existing_processes.name: Deal price and invoice discrepancy resolution

existing_processes.description: Traders, schedulers and accounting ask the desk to create, amend, rate-change, path, split or clean up Sitara and Tagg deal tickets and confirm the deal number back.
existing_processes.name: Sitara deal ticket entry and correction requests

existing_processes.description: Risk, credit or middle office send lists of deals or terminated counterparties to move or flip between trading books, including bankruptcy books, and the book admin moves them and confirms before books are calculated.
existing_processes.name: Deal and counterparty book transfers

existing_processes.description: The periodic credit report listing counterparties to rebook, pending credit or do-not-confirm is forwarded to book admins, who rebook deals or take credit reserves.
existing_processes.name: Credit report distribution and rebooking

existing_processes.description: Requests to create or map books, curves, portfolio codes and EOL products in Tagg/Sitara, and to grant or change user IDs, logins and access for desk staff.
existing_processes.name: Trading book setup and system access requests

existing_processes.description: Daily, monthly and revised gas nominations from counterparties such as Calpine, plus volume and election changes, are received, keyed into scheduling systems and confirmed.
existing_processes.name: Counterparty nomination intake and changes

existing_processes.description: Gas control, field operations and on-call staff report shut-ins, cuts, maintenance, leaks and weekend activity that schedulers must read and act on.
existing_processes.name: Pipeline operations, shut-in and outage notice relay

existing_processes.description: Scheduled versus measured volumes and imbalances on pipelines and interconnect OBAs are reconciled with counterparties, with support sent and paybacks or cash-outs approved.
existing_processes.name: Pipeline and OBA imbalance reconciliation

existing_processes.description: Shippers ask to change Transwestern contract receipts, MDQ, names or capacity, and the account director approves and forwards the request to contract administration to amend.
existing_processes.name: Transportation contract amendment approvals

existing_processes.description: Each week California deliveries, capacity utilization and Gas Daily prices are compiled and emailed to the Transwestern commercial team.
existing_processes.name: Weekly California capacity report

existing_processes.description: CAISO notices on derates, settlements, procedures and market changes are read and forwarded to the real-time desk so it can adjust.
existing_processes.name: CAISO market notice relay

existing_processes.description: The real-time desk lead repeatedly emails procedures and rules on deal entry in Enpower, tags, cuts, checkouts and scheduling that shift traders must follow.
existing_processes.name: Real-time desk standing procedures

existing_processes.description: The desk lead tells the shift the day's long and short positions, deals to enter and books to use, and shift operators report missed schedules and problems back.
existing_processes.name: Real-time position and shift handoff

existing_processes.description: The real-time desk reconciles Enpower deals, congestion revenue, annuities and prior-month adjustments against CAPS, inc sheets and settlement flashes, and chases corrections before the P&L flash.
existing_processes.name: Real-time congestion and deal settlement reconciliation

existing_processes.description: Producing, reviewing and approving daily P&L and position reports, officializing post IDs, and answering P&L flash, Schedule C and book list questions.
existing_processes.name: Daily P&L, position and post ID sign-off

existing_processes.description: Auditors, management and other groups request deal tickets, P&L support, origination detail, curve validation explanations or counterparty deal lists, which the desk pulls and sends.
existing_processes.name: Deal data and audit support requests

existing_processes.description: Finance repeatedly asks operations groups for activity and hours surveys, budget questionnaires and cost-center allocation checks by a deadline.
existing_processes.name: Cost center surveys and allocation requests
